related_issues.reason: Another request to reduce the burden of per-vulnerability --ignore/--ignore-until-fixed lists in uv audit (via a VEX file).
Also about ergonomics of the ignore-until-fixed setting in uv audit.
Roadmap/tracking issue for uv audit; post-MVP features are tracked there.
Another uv audit filtering enhancement (--direct-only), different request.

rationale: The reporter asks for a new magic value ALL for ignore-until-fixed so uv audit shows only vulnerabilities that already have a fix. This is new behaviour on a working feature, not a bug, and the report has no error or reproduction needs. Searches found no issue with the same request, only related uv-audit enhancements (#19981, #19265, #18912) and the roadmap #18506. The proposal is somewhat muddled, since ignore-until-fixed takes vulnerability IDs and ignores unfixed ones, and the reporter writes ruff in places. A maintainer may want a differently shaped flag, such as a fix-available-only filter. I did not read a uv audit docs page; the docs search returned nothing relevant.
